notes: Downgrading, in Settings > Updates. Type a rev or a commit and the client reloads onto that build; Return to latest clears it. The pin is written to the config, so it survives a reload, and the teleport queue re-runs the pinned commit instead of the branch - a downgrade that reverted on the next teleport would not be one. Revs are resolved from the commit messages, since "(rev 64)" is the only place a build proves which rev it is; one call for the last hundred commits covers every build so far. Update prompts stay quiet while pinned, and a pin whose build cannot be downloaded is dropped on the spot rather than bricking every later launch. The player card's gap from 65 rides along.
